text_block_list.text: (Woosh…… woosh……)

A refreshing breeze in the seaside night. 
The pleasant sound of the waves…

So peaceful, so far away from the hustle 
and bustle of the city. How on earth did I 
end up here……?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: YAHOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey!! This ain't no time to be 
playing dead, trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: On your feet! Stand up! It's time for you to wake up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huuh? The heck, you don't remember?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The day that darkness covered the world… 
The day nearly all hope was snuffed from 
these lands.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But as luck would have it, earth had a 
savior in lord Gold Ship…!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She crossed the oceans, she crossed the 
mountains, in search of Eden… All to save 
this world……!
The word "Eden" jogged some vague memory…
― Right, it was a few days prior.

When I was walking, thinking about the 
Twinkles Series which was about to start…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, trainer, hear me out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take a peek at the geological 
strata so I starting drilling a hole in 
this field, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And would you know it, I happened upon 
this Enigmatic Tome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Eden, that is, the utopia that only 
horsegirls of great power can reach……"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Goldship, mightiest of horsegirls, hear. 
Aim to reach Eden — by Enigmatic Tome"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don't that mean I was chosen by Eden?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wooooooo! It lights the fire in meeee!

"by Enigmatic Tome", really? She thinks it 
would say that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The heck!? You don't understand the worth 
of little old Golshi, desired even by 
Eden, do you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I didn't wanna get rough, but you leave me 
no choice—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ……And, yoop!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry. I ain't gonna slide you 
in my menchi-katsu like a piece of 
cabbage.
And that was how we ended up here…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, 'bout our next course of action—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
… You have one of those cardinal clocks 
they call a compass?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Remember? You lost all our food and your 
smartphone while swimming in the ocean?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So never mind Eden, I don't even know 
which way home is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, maybe I could think about spending 
the rest of my life here, but…
How in blazes has it come to this…!!
